plate.note: Cool the warm reflection so silver separates from the brass.

lame.note: Overlapping lower lames are darker than the main plate.

mail.note: Dark mail in the gaps between rigid plates.

navy.note: Separate the hanging cloth from both steel and deep shadow.

gilt.note: Warm trim contrasts with the cool plate.

skin.note: Expand the sampled lit cheek into three distinguishable tones.

hair.note: Dark fringe under the raised visor.

field.note: Deep heraldic blue, separated from the tabard.

lily.note: The gold charge must remain legible against the blue even in shadow.

rim.note: Muted rim keeps the central charge brightest.

blade.note: Silver in a separate shading group.

edge.note: Bright bevel along the cutting edges.
